claims.text: The driver's own trace shows he held position inside the pickup geofence for only 57 continuous seconds, far short of the 180-second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip. The trip record confirms the free waiting period was 180 seconds and that the wait timer started at 14:22:42, yet the driver cancelled at 14:23:41 — 59 seconds later. The required dwell was never served, so the cancellation fee is not chargeable and must be refunded in full.

The shortfall is arithmetic and undisputed: the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 57 seconds against a 180-second minimum, a shortfall of 123 seconds. POL-NS-06 makes this strict liability — the fee is refunded whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. The rider's message 'coming out now' at 14:23:40, one second before the driver cancelled, shows the rider was actively emerging; the driver did not wait even the free period he was required to give.

The rider's own device track places her within the rider-presence radius for the STANDARD zone class throughout the waiting window — 19 qualifying fixes, all within a maximum of 7.4 metres of the pickup pin, at zero speed. She was at the pickup point, stationary, and messaging the driver. The rider did everything the platform asks of her; the failure to complete the pickup was the driver's premature cancellation.

The rider sent a locating message — 'coming out now' — at 14:23:40, and the driver neither replied in the chat log within 120 seconds nor placed any in-app voice call before terminating the trip. The chat log shows a single message from the rider and no driver response; the trip record shows zero in-app calls. Under POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b), the rider is exonerated and the fee refunded in full with no driver compensation.

The driver's counterparty statement asks the tribunal to check the rider's profile for a 'history of no-shows'. That is an invitation to reason from reputation, which POL-GEN-01 forbids: no profile field may establish a fact about this trip. The only profile field the no-show category permits for an adverse finding against a rider is rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d under POL-NS-09(d), and that field reads 1 — below the threshold of 3 that clause sets. The lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is expressly not the field POL-NS-09(d) reads and may not be substituted for it.

The driver's own profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 1 against completed_trips_30d of 58 — a rate of 0.017, far below the 0.08 threshold, and an absolute count far below the 4 required. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so there is no basis to withhold or escalate on that ground. The driver's record is not the issue; the issue is that he cancelled 59 seconds into a 180-second waiting period.

The fare breakdown confirms the rider was charged SGD 4.50 as a cancellation fee, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. That is the amount the rider contests and the amount that must be returned. The fee line reconciles to the platform-published cancellation fee of SGD 4.50, so there is no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d) — the charge is simply not chargeable on these facts.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING — no advisory covers this pickup road in this window. Under POL-NS-06(i), a MISSING traffic_advisory makes the accumulation limb unavailable: the driver cannot claim his dwell should be summed across intervals because there is no advisory to support it. The absence is itself citable, and it removes the only route by which the driver could argue the 57-second run should count for more.

The GPS trace is complete — 100% coverage, 10-second cadence, no gaps, both driver and rider tracks present — and the trip record is causally ordered with no clock skew. There is no impairment under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d): the arrival event at 14:22:40 matches the first qualifying fix at 14:22:40, the trace has 69 fixes with no gap, the chat log's single message matches the trip record's chat_message_count of 1, and the fare line reconciles. The evidence deciding this case is clean, so the ruling may rest on it at full weight.

The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 14:22:40 and the trace places him inside the geofence at that moment, so the arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05 — he was genuinely there. But being genuinely there does not help him: the waiting clock ran from 14:22:40 and he cancelled at 14:23:41, 61 seconds later, well short of the 180 seconds the rider paid for. The fee is refunded in full under POL-NS-06 and no driver compensation is payable.

On the face of the driver's own evidence, POL-NS-01 limb (c) is not met and the fee is not chargeable. I concede this point: the record does not support the charge on the dwell limb.

The arrival marker is not false, and the driver should not be tagged with a false-arrival referral. The 'I'm Here' tap at 14:22:40 coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 14:22:40, and the driver's speed at that moment is 0.0 kph — well below the 15 kph motion threshold — and his distance from the pin is 1.13 m, far inside the 300 m ceiling. POL-NS-05 does not fire, so the waiting clock is not recomputed and no false-arrival event is recorded against the driver.

The rider was present at the pickup point throughout the waiting window: the rider's track shows 19 fixes, all at 0.0 kph, with a maximum distance of 7.42 m from the pin — well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius — and 19 qualifying fixes. The rider was not absent; she was standing at the pin. This is not a genuine no-show in the sense of a rider who never came.

The rider sent a locating message — 'coming out now' — at 14:23:40, one second before the driver cancelled at 14:23:41. The driver neither replied in the chat log nor placed an in-app voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty). Under POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b), the rider's message was unanswered and the driver terminated the trip without any attempt to coordinate. The rider was at the pin and actively trying to reach the vehicle.

The driver's counterparty statement asserts 'This rider has a history of no-shows, check the profile.' That assertion is not supported by the citable field. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 — a single dispute, not a pattern — and rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags (6) is a LIFETIME counter that POL-GEN-01 expressly forbids substituting for the trailing-30-day figure. The driver's reputation-based argument is discarded under POL-GEN-01.

The driver's own profile shows no_show_terminations_30d = 1 and completed_trips_30d = 58, giving a rate of 0.017 — far below the 0.08 threshold — and the absolute count is below 4. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so the driver is not a fee-farmer and his compensation is not withheld on that ground. I state this honestly: the anti-farming guard does not help the rider here.

The fare breakdown shows the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 was charged and remains CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd = 0.00. The rider filed this dispute. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION on a rider-filed dispute leaves that charge standing — it is not a rider win. The rider's claim for a refund is supported by the dwell shortfall under POL-NS-06, and the full SGD 4.50 should be returned.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road: EV-ADVIS-02754-01 is MISSING with a BLOCKING issue, weight 0.0. The absence of an advisory is itself citable and it does not rescue the short dwell.

ruling.explanation: To both parties: the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 is refunded to the rider in full. The material facts are not disputed. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 14:22:40 (EV-TRIP-02754) and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02754) places him about 1.1 m from the pickup pin, stationary, at that moment — so the arrival marker is genuine, POL-NS-05 does not fire, and no false-arrival referral is recorded. What fails is the waiting period. The free wait in force for this STANDARD-zone trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and the longest continuous qualifying in-geofence run in the trace is 57 seconds (14:22:40 to 14:23:37, 7 qualifying fixes), a shortfall of 123 seconds. The driver cancelled at 14:23:41, about 61 seconds after arriving. POL-NS-01 limb (c) therefore fails, and under POL-NS-06 an effective dwell shorter than the free waiting period makes the fee not chargeable whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded. That is strict liability, so the full SGD 4.50 shown charged on EV-FARE-02754 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is returned; the contested amount is SGD 4.50. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 independently exonerates the rider — her device track (EV-GPS-02754) shows her within about 7.4 m of the pin across the waiting window, and her 'coming out now' message at 14:23:40 (EV-CHAT-02754) drew no reply within 120 seconds and no in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty) — though the refund does not depend on that. On the driver's counterparty statement asking the tribunal to check the rider's profile for a 'history of no-shows': that is reputation reasoning, which POL-GEN-01 forbids, as no profile field may establish a fact about this trip. The only field the no-show category permits for an adverse finding against a rider is rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which reads 1, below the threshold of 3 in POL-NS-09(d); the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags may not be substituted for it. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip either — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and the rate against 58 completed trips in 30 days is 0.017 (below 0.08) — so nothing turns on the driver's record. The two claims that sought to rely on the MISSING traffic advisory were discarded by the referee for not disclosing its issue code, and in any event POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation limb is unavailable and there is only one in-geofence run, so the 57-second dwell stands on its own. The evidence is clean — 100% GPS coverage, no gaps, causally ordered trip record matching timestamps, and a fare line that reconciles to the SGD 4.50 fee — so there is no impairment under POL-NS-08 and the ruling rests on these artifacts at full weight. Confidence 0.95, above the 0.70 escalation floor. The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is at or below the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold, so the refund executes on issue, subject to either party's right of appeal.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02754 is refunded in full.

Why the fee is not chargeable. A no-show fee stands only if all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. Limb (c) fails on the driver's own evidence. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02754) shows the driver's longest continuous in-geofence holding run was 57 seconds, from 14:22:40 to 14:23:37, over 7 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. His arrival marker is genuine: he was stationary (0.0 kph) about 1.1 m from the pin, so POL-NS-05 does not fire and the waiting clock is not recomputed. The free waiting period in force is 180 seconds (EV-TRIP-02754, platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The shortfall is 123 seconds, and the driver cancelled at 14:23:41, before that period elapsed. POL-NS-06 makes this strict liability: the fee is refunded in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied.

Independently, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider. She sent the locating message 'coming out now' at 14:23:40 (EV-CHAT-02754); the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed any in-app call before terminating (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty); and her device track (EV-GPS-02754) places her within 7.4 m of the pickup pin for 19 qualifying fixes. All three limbs hold.

The advocates' claims on the dwell, on the genuineness of the arrival marker, on the rider's presence, on the unanswered message, on the anti-farming check and on the fare line are accepted; they are consistent and they all point the same way. Driver compensation is nil: POL-NS-07 applies only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not, and the anti-farming check would not bite in any event (no_show_terminations_30d = 1 against completed_trips_30d = 58, a rate of 0.017). No false-arrival referral arises under POL-NS-05, and the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW is a limb (d) code, so the POL-NS-01 driver-education referral for a mis-selected code does not apply. No clause produces any other referral.

The counterparty statement ('This rider has a history of no-shows, check the profile') is not a ground of decision. POL-GEN-01 makes every profile field context-only except those a clause names; the field the no-show category reads for an adverse rider finding, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, is 1, below the threshold of 3 in POL-NS-09(d), and the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags (6) is expressly not that field.

No impairment under POL-NS-08(a)-(d): the arrival event and the first qualifying fix both sit at 14:22:40 (no clock skew); the trace has 100% coverage, 10 s cadence and no gap over 120 seconds; the chat log's single message matches trip_record.chat_message_count; and the SGD 4.50 fare line reconciles to the platform-published fee. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02754-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) is not relied on and carries nothing; it only makes the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation limb unavailable, which changes nothing because the dwell is short on the single interval.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the artifacts do not contradict each other, there is no repeat-party pattern, the anti-farming check does not trip, and the deciding evidence is unimpaired. Confidence is capped by the artifacts that carry the deciding fact, EV-GPS-02754 and EV-TRIP-02754, both at weight 1.0.

The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00 and is executed automatically on issue; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the record is unusually clear and both advocates read the key numbers the same way.

What happened: the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 14:22:40 and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02754) puts him 1.1 m from the pickup pin at that instant, stationary at 0.0 km/h. The arrival marker is genuine and POL-NS-05 does not fire — no false-arrival referral is recorded against the driver. But the free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip is 180 seconds (EV-TRIP-02754, platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). His longest continuous in-geofence dwell was 57 seconds (14:22:40 to 14:23:37, 7 qualifying fixes), a shortfall of 123 seconds, and he cancelled at 14:23:41. POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails and limb (d) fails with it, because the cancellation did not fall at or after the required dwell. POL-NS-06 then applies directly and is strict about it: where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the free waiting period, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded.

The rider was in fact present and trying to coordinate: her device shows 19 stationary fixes never more than 7.4 m from the pin, inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, and she sent 'coming out now' at 14:23:40, one second before the cancellation. The driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor made any in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty). POL-NS-04 points the same way; the refund already follows from POL-NS-06, so nothing turns on it.

The money: EV-FARE-02754 shows the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, total_charged 4.50). The whole SGD 4.50 is refunded. No driver compensation is payable — POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and POL-NS-06 displaces it. No POL-NS-03 pin-ambiguity goodwill (2.25) applies, because the driver's stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not outside it.

Points raised that do not change this: the driver's counterparty statement asking us to check the rider's 'history of no-shows' is not a ground of decision. POL-GEN-01 makes prior_no_show_flags (6) context-only; the only citable counter, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, reads 1, below the POL-NS-09(d) threshold of 3, and both profiles' disputes_with_counterparty_90d read 0. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1 against completed_trips_30d 58, rate 0.017), so there is no escalation and no withholding of compensation on that ground. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02754-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0); it bears only on POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation route, which is unavailable and in any event unnecessary — there was a single 57-second interval to measure.

Weight and confidence: the artifacts carrying the deciding facts, EV-GPS-02754 and EV-TRIP-02754, are both at weight_multiplier 1.0, and nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08 (no clock skew, no trace gap, chat sequence intact, fare line reconciles to the platform-published SGD 4.50). The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this ruling executes automatically. Either party may appeal within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

Decision for both parties: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable.

Why. Both representatives accept the arithmetic, and I agree with it. The driver accepted the trip at 14:13:12, tapped 'I'm Here' at 14:22:40, and the platform's wait timer started at 14:22:42. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02754) places him at the pickup pin — 1.13 m away, speed 0.0 kph — with only 7 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a single continuous in-geofence run of 57 seconds (14:22:40 to 14:23:37). He cancelled at 14:23:41.

The free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, EV-TRIP-02754). POL-NS-01 requires all four conditions for a no-show fee, and its limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the arrival tap. The 57-second dwell fell 123 seconds short of the 180-second minimum, so the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01. The refund is then decided under POL-NS-06: an effective in-geofence dwell (57 s) shorter than the free waiting period (180 s) means the cancellation fee is refunded in full, whatever the rider did or did not do. POL-NS-07 only compensates a verified no-show, so the driver's compensation is nil.

Points I did not need to reach, but answer. The arrival marker is genuine: the tap at 14:22:40 coincides with the first in-radius fix, at 1.13 m from the pin and 0.0 kph, so POL-NS-05 does not fire and no false-arrival referral is recorded. The rider's own track (19 fixes, all at 0.0 kph, maximum 7.42 m from the pin — inside the 100 m STANDARD radius) and her unanswered message 'coming out now' at 14:23:40 would independently exonerate her under POL-NS-04, which points the same way. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02754-01, MISSING, weight 0.0) makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulation unavailable, but it is immaterial: there is only one in-geofence run to count.

On the driver's counterparty statement asking the tribunal to 'check the profile' for a history of no-shows: I reject it as a ground. POL-GEN-01 makes every profile field context-only except the ones a clause names, and it expressly forbids substituting the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags (6) for rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which reads 1 — below the 3 that policy requires to matter. A reputation assertion establishes nothing about this trip. The driver's anti-farming check also does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below 4; 1/58 = 0.017, below 0.08), so nothing is withheld on that ground.

Evidence quality and escalation. There is no impairment under POL-NS-08(a)–(d): the arrival event matches the GPS fix to the second, the trace carries 69 fixes with no gap over 120 seconds, the chat log's single message matches the recorded chat count, and the SGD 4.50 fare line reconciles to the platform cancellation fee. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires — confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict one another, and neither profile shows repeat no-show disputes between these parties.

Effect. The refund amount is SGD 4.50, taken from fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee (EV-FARE-02754, currently charged, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). That is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the refund executes automatically. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
